The Creation of Ottawa County's Web Based Map
The Ottawa County Engineer’s Office has created a quick, easy way to access Ottawa County survey data. The creation of a Geographic Information System (GIS) enables individuals to obtain documents in one location. They are easy to access and search through the GIS Mapping program. The information is available 24/7 to all who have internet access. The site will continue to be developed and enhanced. If you do not see a document you would like to view please contact the Engineer's Office for additional information on how you may obtain copies of available documents.
Legal Disclaimer
The GIS information provided in this map was prepared by the Ottawa County Engineer’s Office with assistance of the Ottawa County’s Auditor’s Office for parcel data information. The map is intended to provide a means of access to survey plats, subdivision plats, subdivision improvement plans, and survey control point data (section corner data and benchmark data). The parcel / boundary lines and aerial photography included in this map are for graphical information purposes only. The Ottawa County Engineer’s Office makes no representation to its accuracy, merchantability or fitness for any other purpose, express or implied. Any user of this information accepts the same “as is”, “with all faults”, and assumes all responsibility for any use other than the intent stated above. The user of this data agrees to hold the Ottawa County Engineer’s Office and all participating agents listed above, harmless from and against any damage, loss or liability from any use of the information contained therein.
